verdict.rationale: Appwrite Storage documents a preview endpoint that resizes, crops, converts format, sets quality, adds borders and rotates images from a single upload. It also offers smart crop focus via gravity=auto and serves files through the Appwrite CDN, so no self-run image pipeline is needed. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the preview endpoint, in-depth reference docs on transformation parameters, caching and limits.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve resized or transformed images from storage without running my own image pipeline

citations.quote: Use the preview endpoint to resize, crop, convert format, set quality, add borders, and rotate from a single upload.
Pass gravity=auto and YuNet looks for a face first.
